title: Software Developer
description: Designs, builds, tests, and maintains apps, websites, and digital platforms to solve real-world user problems.
educationPathway: BS Software Engineering or BS Computer Science
workEnvironment: Software companies, tech teams, hybrid offices

title: Doctor / Physician
description: Diagnoses illnesses, guides preventive health, and cares directly for patients in clinics and hospitals.
educationPathway: Pre-Medical followed by MBBS / Medical School
workEnvironment: Hospitals, medical clinics, community health centers

title: Psychologist
description: Studies human behavior and supports mental well-being, learning, and personal decision-making.
educationPathway: BS & MS in Psychology or Counselling
workEnvironment: Schools, clinics, hospitals, wellness centers

title: Teacher / Educator
description: Plans engaging lessons, mentors students, and helps learners build academic confidence and life skills.
educationPathway: Bachelor's degree in subject area + Teaching Qualification (B.Ed)
workEnvironment: Schools, colleges, training centers

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Designs, builds, and improves machines, engines, robotics, and manufacturing equipment.
educationPathway: Pre-Engineering followed by BE / BS Mechanical Engineering
workEnvironment: Engineering plants, R&D workshops, industrial labs

title: Architect
description: Blends visual design and structural planning to create functional, inspiring buildings and public spaces.
educationPathway: 5-year Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch)
workEnvironment: Architecture studios and construction sites

title: Graphic Designer
description: Creates visual identities, logos, illustrations, and digital layouts that communicate ideas clearly.
educationPathway: BFA Communication Design or BS Graphic Design
workEnvironment: Design studios, media agencies, brand teams

title: Accountant
description: Prepares financial statements, tracks budgets, audits records, and ensures financial accuracy.
educationPathway: BS Accounting & Finance, ACCA, or CA
workEnvironment: Accounting firms, corporate offices, banks

title: Lawyer
description: Researches laws, advises clients, drafts agreements, and advocates persuasively in legal matters.
educationPathway: LL.B Law Degree & Bar Qualification
workEnvironment: Law chambers, courts, corporate legal teams

title: Business Manager
description: Guides teams, oversees daily operations, manages budgets, and helps organizations achieve strategic goals.
educationPathway: BBA followed by MBA or Business Management degree
workEnvironment: Corporate offices, commercial organizations

title: Entrepreneur
description: Spots new opportunities, builds original products or services, rallies teams, and launches new ventures.
educationPathway: BS Entrepreneurship, BBA, or technical domain degree
workEnvironment: Startups, incubators, independent ventures

title: Data Analyst
description: Explores datasets, builds clear charts, and uncovers patterns that help organizations make smarter decisions.
educationPathway: BS Data Science, Statistics, or Computer Science
workEnvironment: Tech companies, banks, research centers

title: Research Scientist
description: Designs controlled experiments, studies natural or medical phenomena, and publishes new scientific findings.
educationPathway: BS & MS / PhD in Biology, Chemistry, Physics, or Biotechnology
workEnvironment: University labs, research institutes, pharmaceutical R&D

title: Journalist
description: Investigates public stories, interviews people, verifies facts, and reports clearly across print and digital media.
educationPathway: BS Mass Communication, Journalism, or English
workEnvironment: Newsrooms, broadcast studios, field reporting

title: Marketing Specialist
description: Understands customer needs, shapes brand messaging, and runs creative digital and community campaigns.
educationPathway: BBA Marketing or BS Digital Media & Communication
workEnvironment: Marketing agencies, brand teams, e-commerce firms

title: UX / UI Designer
description: Studies how people use apps and websites, and designs intuitive, welcoming digital interfaces.
educationPathway: BS Interaction Design, Computer Science, or Digital Design
workEnvironment: Product design teams, software houses

title: Social Worker
description: Supports families and communities, connects people with helpful programs, and advocates for student and public welfare.
educationPathway: BS Social Work, Sociology, or Development Studies
workEnvironment: Schools, community organizations, hospitals, NGOs

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Defends networks and digital data by spotting vulnerabilities, monitoring threats, and securing systems.
educationPathway: BS Cyber Security or BS Computer Science
workEnvironment: Security operations centers, banks, tech firms

title: Civil Engineer
description: Plans, designs, and supervises construction of bridges, roads, buildings, and clean water systems.
educationPathway: Pre-Engineering followed by BE / BS Civil Engineering
workEnvironment: Construction sites and engineering consultancies

title: Human Resources Specialist
description: Helps organizations hire great people, organize staff training, and build supportive workplaces.
educationPathway: BBA (HR) or BS Organizational Psychology
workEnvironment: Corporate offices, universities, hospitals

title: Environmental Scientist
description: Studies ecosystems, water, air quality, and climate impacts to protect nature and sustainable resources.
educationPathway: BS Environmental Sciences or Ecology
workEnvironment: Field sites, testing laboratories, conservation agencies

title: Veterinarian
description: Diagnoses and treats illnesses in pets, livestock, and wildlife while promoting animal health and welfare.
educationPathway: Pre-Medical followed by Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM)
workEnvironment: Veterinary clinics, animal hospitals, farms, wildlife reserves

title: Pharmacist
description: Prepares and verifies safe medications, conducts lab quality checks, and advises doctors and patients.
educationPathway: Pre-Medical followed by 5-year Pharm-D
workEnvironment: Hospital pharmacies, community pharmacies, pharma labs

title: Finance Specialist
description: Evaluates budgets, forecasts investments, and guides businesses and families toward sound financial plans.
educationPathway: BS Finance, Economics, or Accounting & Finance
workEnvironment: Banks, investment firms, corporate finance departments

title: Content Creator
description: Produces educational videos, podcasts, photography, and engaging storytelling for digital communities.
educationPathway: BS Media Production, Communication, or Digital Arts
workEnvironment: Media studios, digital teams, independent production

title: Project Manager
description: Coordinates schedules, budgets, and cross-functional teams so complex projects finish smoothly on time.
educationPathway: Bachelor's in Business, Engineering, or IT + Project Management Certification
workEnvironment: Tech firms, engineering offices, corporate organizations
